description: This test module verifies the behavior of the `is_model_response_stream_empty` function from `litellm.litellm_core_utils.model_response_utils` using mock `ModelResponseStream` objects with various `choices` and `delta` contents.

classes.name: ModelResponseStream
classes.description: Represents a stream of model responses, containing metadata and choices.

classes.name: StreamingChoices
classes.description: Represents a single choice within a model response stream, including finish reason, index, delta, and log probabilities.

classes.name: Delta
classes.description: Contains detailed information about the delta in a streaming choice, including optional provider-specific fields and content.

methods.name: test_is_model_response_stream_empty()
methods.description: Tests that a `ModelResponseStream` with empty delta fields is considered empty by `is_model_response_stream_empty`.

methods.name: test_is_model_response_stream_empty_with_custom_value()
methods.description: Tests that a `ModelResponseStream` with a custom added field in delta is considered non-empty by `is_model_response_stream_empty`.
